Power loss, had to pull off road. multiple fault codes on this event. 2 broken plastic parts in intake duct, one stuck in throttle body butterfly. cleared plastic parts from intake to get home. Later determined 2 of 4 intake resonator tube internal catch bevels broke off. The remaining 2 were very weak and easily broke off as well. Serious FOD hazard to engine!

The contact owns a 2021 Toyota Camry. The contact stated that while driving approximately 40 MPH, a second vehicle T-boned the vehicle while driving approximately 60 MPH and crashed into the driver’s side of the vehicle. During the crash, no air bags had deployed inside the vehicle, including the side curtain air bags. Police and Emergency Services were called to the scene. The contact had to be extracted from the vehicle and was transported to a nearby hospital. During the crash, the contact sustained a concussion and left hip and left torso injuries. A Police report was filed at the scene, and the vehicle was towed to a nearby salvage yard. The cause of the failure was not yet determined. The manufacturer and local dealer were not yet contacted. The failure mileage was 83,000.

2021 Camry with 29,000 miles panoramic roof is stuck in the vent position.  Took it to two different automotive shops and was told they could not close the vent.  The concern was too much pressure on the glass could cause it to shatter if they forced it to close.  The recommended repair was to replace the entire sunroof assembly.  A private auto garage quoted almost $15,000 to repair.  Toyota confirmed the original diagnosis and quoted $10,600 plus tax.  If the glass shatters, it obviously is a safety risk.  Currently, the car is unusable as is.  Two automotive centers confirmed the diagnosis.  No warnings, the sunroof stopped responding. When googling, it appears many Camry owners have had the same issue.  Contacted Toyota and was denied any assistance. The car has never been in an accident so it is hard to understand why there would be a bent mechanism other than a quality issue.  Both diagnosis invoices are available upon request.
